rows.Name: Super
rows.Description: Oxblood lacquer over a pantographed crown, and a Super Record groupset that shifts like it did the day it left Cambiago. It came to us with a seized seatpost; it leaves with every bearing repacked.

rows.Name: PX-10
rows.Description: The French racer that won everything, rebuilt from a barn find. The pearl paint is original under forty years of grime; the brown leather saddle is new and already breaking in.

rows.Name: Pista
rows.Description: A true velodrome frame: steep angles, short wheelbase, one fixed gear. Stripped, straightened and rebuilt with the original Pista hubs and a pair of hand-built tubular wheels.

rows.Name: Torino
rows.Description: Cream lacquer, chrome lugs and gumwall tyres. A racer's bike that spent thirty years as a commuter — the frame is straight, the drivetrain is new, and it wants to go fast again.

rows.Name: Randonneur
rows.Description: Racing green with a leather frame bag, racks front and back, and gearing low enough for a loaded climb. Built for the long way round, and ready for it.

rows.Name: Grand Record
rows.Description: Feather-light French tubing and the Huret Jubilee, the lightest derailleur of its day. New tyres, new cables, and the original bar tape replaced with cloth, as it should be.

rows.Name: Supercorsa
rows.Description: The winged-C badge and full chrome under clear lacquer. Sold to a rider in Lyon who promised to take it up the Ventoux before hanging it on the wall.
